upright.about: Sat up in a chair, the back straight and a touch forward, the knees together, the hands loose in the lap: an interview, a waiting room.

slump.about: Dead inside: slid forward on the seat, the back rounded, the chest sunk, the chin down, the hands dropped in the lap, the knees apart.

typing.about: At a desk, the back easy and a little forward, both hands on the keys.

leanIn.about: Locked in: the back bent hard toward the screen, the face close to it, the elbows up and out, both hands hammering the keys.

mouse.about: At a desk, one hand on the keys and the near one out on the mouse, the shoulder turned a little to it.

reachClick.about: Reaching forward across the desk to press something on the screen or the keyboard with the near hand, deliberately, the body leaning after it; the other hand on the desk's edge.

toMouth.about: At a desk, the near hand raised to the mouth holding something to it (a mug to drink from, or bite), the elbow down and in, the other hand on the desk; the back easy.

triumph.about: At a desk, the near hand thrust straight up holding something high in triumph, the far hand down on the desk; the chest up, the chin up.
